document:
query userDeveloper($id: ID!) {
  user(id: $id) {
    ...DeveloperUserFragment
  }
}

fragment DeveloperUserFragment on User {
  id
  kind
  registeredAt
  registrationCompleted
  status
  limitedReason
  language
  tags
  appVersion
  phone
  email
  authProvider
  feedVariant
  detectedGender
  locationPinned
  ipCountryCode
  location {
    country
    state
    city
    suburb
  }
  premiumGrant {
    daysLeft
    expiresAt
    localizedPrice
  }
  balance
  ledgerEntriesCount
  momentsCount
  reactionsCount
  messagesCount
  connectionsCount
  lastMomentAt
  notificationsMuted
  device {
    brand
    deviceModel
    deviceOs
    language
  }
}
